l-m-h3-b0c50-28.title: Fixing Claim After Counterexample
l-m-h3-b0c50-28.goal: When you revise claim to consider counterexample, weigh di conditions wey clash, choose di best compromise, and explain why.
l-m-h3-b0c50-28.material: Claim: All prime numbers odd. Counterexample 2 show up. You wan fix di claim, and e must avoid di counterexample while staying true for as many prime numbers as possible.
l-m-h3-b0c50-28.s.s1.prompt: Which claim meet both conditions and most suitable?
l-m-h3-b0c50-28.s.s1.o.b: All prime numbers bigger than 2 odd
l-m-h3-b0c50-28.s.s1.o.c: Di only odd primes na 3, 5, and 7
l-m-h3-b0c50-28.s.s1.r.c: Other odd primes like 11 dey, so e false.
l-m-h3-b0c50-28.s.s1.r.d: Prime numbers like 2, 3, 5 dey, so e false.
l-m-h3-b0c50-28.s.s1.explain: Prime number wey bigger than 2 no fit be multiple of 2, so e odd. E avoid counterexample 2 and still include all other primes.
l-m-h3-b0c50-28.s.s2.model.0: Prime number bigger than 2 go divide by 2 if e even, so e odd; e remove only counterexample 2, making am widest true claim.
l-m-h3-b0c50-28.s.s2.model.1: 3, 5, 7 na odd primes, so claim say dem even false, while adding 'bigger than 2' make statement true and widest.

l-m-h3-b0d07-08.title: Grant: big amount for first year, total within limit
l-m-h3-b0d07-08.goal: Think about all conditions wey dey conflict for first-year amount of grant wey dey reduce every year, choose di best balance, and explain why.
l-m-h3-b0d07-08.material: Dem give grant every year. First year amount na a (in 10,000 won), and each next year na r times di previous year. Even if e continue forever, total must no pass 100 × 10,000 won, second year must be at least 70% of first year, and first year suppose be di largest.
l-m-h3-b0d07-08.s.s1.prompt: Which plan meet every condition and make first year di largest?
l-m-h3-b0d07-08.s.s1.r.a: E meet conditions, but person fit make first year bigger while total stay within 100 × 10,000 won.
l-m-h3-b0d07-08.s.s1.r.d: Total na 100 (in 10,000 won units), but second year na 60%, wey no reach 70%.
l-m-h3-b0d07-08.s.s1.explain: Total na a/(1−r)≤100 and r≥0.7. When r=0.7, a≤30, so 30 × 10,000 won for first year na di largest.
l-m-h3-b0d07-08.s.s2.model.0: r must be at least 0.7 and total a/(1−r)≤100, so a=30 when r=0.7 na maximum, making dis plan most suitable.
l-m-h3-b0d07-08.s.s2.model.1: If you increase r, a≤100(1−r) go become smaller; if you lower r, you break di 70% condition. So r=0.7, a=30 na di balance.

l-m-h3-b0d07-13.material: Ball drop from height of 3m and bounce each time to r times di previous height. Elasticity r must be at least 0.5, and total distance until e stop must be at most 15m. From these, make r as big as possible.
l-m-h3-b0d07-13.s.s1.prompt: Which plan meet all conditions and make r biggest?

l-m-h3-b0d07-13.s.s1.r.b: Elasticity less than 0.5, so e break di conditions.
l-m-h3-b0d07-13.s.s1.explain: From total distance 3(1+r)/(1−r)≤15, r≤2/3. Biggest r wey meet conditions na 2/3.
l-m-h3-b0d07-13.s.s2.model.0: Total distance 3(1+r)/(1−r) must no pass 15, so r≤2/3, and to make r big, 2/3 best.
l-m-h3-b0d07-13.s.s2.model.1: If r=0.75, e na 21m, wey pass limit; if r=2/3, e exactly 15m, so dis plan get biggest elasticity within limit.

l-m-h3-b0d08-08.goal: For amount d of nutrient solution wey dem add every day, think about all conditions wey dey conflict, choose di best balance, and explain why.
l-m-h3-b0d08-08.material: Dem add di same amount d of nutrient solution to tank every day. After one day, half of wetin remain break down. After long time, amount just before adding must be at least 40 and amount just after adding no more than 90, and amount wey dem add suppose be small.
l-m-h3-b0d08-08.s.s1.prompt: Which d best meet all di conditions?
l-m-h3-b0d08-08.s.s1.r.a: Amount just before adding na 30, wey no reach 40.
l-m-h3-b0d08-08.s.s1.r.c: E meet conditions, but amount wey dem add pass 40.
l-m-h3-b0d08-08.s.s1.r.d: Amount just after adding na 100, wey pass 90.
l-m-h3-b0d08-08.s.s1.explain: After long time, amount before adding become d and amount after adding become 2d. We need d≥40 and 2d≤90, and since amount added suppose be small, d=40.
l-m-h3-b0d08-08.s.s2.model.0: Amount before adding na d, so d≥40 needed; and amount after adding 2d≤90 give d≤45. But to add as little as possible, d=40 fit best.
l-m-h3-b0d08-08.s.s2.model.1: d=30 no effective enough, and d=50 make amount after adding pass di limit, so d=40, di smallest value wey meet both conditions, na di balance.

l-m-h3-b0d08-21.material: Dem build rectangular pen against wall (no fence for wall side). Area must be at least 150 m², side along wall y must be at most 15 m, and di shorter fence length 2x+y, di better.

l-m-h3-b0d08-21.s.s2.model.0: With y≤15 and xy=150, x≥10, and length 2x+150/x increase for x>8.66, so x=10 give shortest length, 35 m.
l-m-h3-b0d08-21.s.s2.model.1: Without limit, x≈8.7 go be shortest, but y go pass 15, so e no allowed. Smallest x wey keep limit, x=10, fit best.

l-m-h3-b0d08-35.s.s2.model.1: a=2 short for height and a=6 pass area limit, so a=3, wey just meet height, use least material.

l-m-h3-b0d08-39.s.s2.model.1: T=4 and 4.5 fail because distance short or velocity too high; T=6 too long, so T=5 meet both and short, suitable.

l-m-h3-b0d09-08.goal: When designing elliptical pond, think about all conflicting conditions, choose best balance, and explain why.
l-m-h3-b0d09-08.material: Dis na elliptical pond wey major axis fixed at 20 m. Minor axis must be at least 12 m, distance between two fountains (foci) at least 10 m, and walking path (perimeter) suppose be as long as possible. If major axis same, di closer to circle, di longer di perimeter.

l-m-h3-b0d09-08.s.s1.r.d: E meet conditions, but perimeter shorter than with 10 m.
l-m-h3-b0d09-08.s.s1.explain: From 2c≥10 and minor axis 2√(100−c²)≥12, we get c≤8, so 5≤c≤8. Perimeter longest at smallest c, 5, meaning 2c=10.
l-m-h3-b0d09-08.s.s2.model.0: Distance between fountains must be at least 10 m, and minor-axis condition give c≤8. Within dat, 2c=10 dey closest to circle and give longest perimeter, so e suitable.
l-m-h3-b0d09-08.s.s2.model.1: 14 m also meet conditions, but e farther from circle and path shorter. So 10 m, di smallest distance wey meet conditions, best.

l-m-h3-b0d09-27.material: River dey flow east with velocity (3, 0). Boat fit move at speed 5 in water and must reach point directly north on other bank. Within dat condition, you wan cross as fast as possible.
l-m-h3-b0d09-27.s.s1.prompt: Which velocity suitable for boat to make (relative to water)?
l-m-h3-b0d09-27.s.s1.r.a: Resultant velocity na (3, 5), so boat drift go east.
l-m-h3-b0d09-27.s.s1.r.b: Resultant velocity na (−2, 0), so boat no fit cross go north.
l-m-h3-b0d09-27.s.s1.r.c: Resultant velocity na (−1, 3), so river push boat go west.
l-m-h3-b0d09-27.s.s1.explain: To cancel east flow (3,0), x-component must be −3. Since magnitude na 5, y-component na 4, and resultant velocity na (0,4).
l-m-h3-b0d09-27.s.s2.model.0: To reach point directly north, x-component of resultant velocity must be 0, so boat x-component na −3. Then y-component na 4, and crossing speed dey highest.
l-m-h3-b0d09-27.s.s2.model.1: (0,5) cross fastest, but boat go drift, so e no allowed. Among choices wey meet condition, (−3,4) best, with resultant velocity 4.

l-m-h3-b0d09-43.goal: As you choose wire path between 2 places, consider conflicting conditions, choose best compromise and explain why.
l-m-h3-b0d09-43.material: Wire connect A(0,0,0) to B(6,0,8) (unit: m). Rule say wire length no pass 12 m, and within dat choose path with lowest total cost (length × unit price).
l-m-h3-b0d09-43.s.s1.o.a: Straight through air, 10 m, unit price 4
l-m-h3-b0d09-43.s.s1.r.a: Na same straight line, but unit price higher, so total cost na 40.

l-m-h3-b0d09-43.s.s1.explain: Straight distance between A and B na √(36+64)=10 m. Among paths 12 m or shorter, lowest cost na 10×3=30.

l-m-h3-b0d10-13.title: How high half-ellipse tunnel suppose be?
l-m-h3-b0d10-13.goal: Decide height of tunnel cross-section by thinking about all conflicting conditions, choose best balance, and explain why.
l-m-h3-b0d10-13.material: Dem go build half-elliptical tunnel over road wey wide 12 m. Cross-section na x²/36 + y²/b² = 1 (y≥0). Truck wey high 4.5 m and wide 4 m must pass through center, and to reduce construction cost, b suppose as small as possible.
l-m-h3-b0d10-13.s.s1.r.a: Truck fit pass, but tunnel must be dug higher than with 5.
l-m-h3-b0d10-13.s.s1.r.c: At truck corner (x=2), height na about 3.8 m, so truck go hit am.
l-m-h3-b0d10-13.s.s1.r.d: Truck fit pass, but height more than needed, so na di most expensive.
l-m-h3-b0d10-13.s.s1.explain: At truck corner x=2, tunnel height na b√(32/36)≈0.943b. For am to be 4.5 or more, b≥4.77, and smallest choice na 5.
l-m-h3-b0d10-13.s.s2.model.0: At x=2, height 0.943b must be at least 4.5, so b≥4.77. To save construction cost, smallest value wey meet condition, 5, suitable.
l-m-h3-b0d10-13.s.s2.model.1: b=4 give height 3.8, wey no reach, so rule am out. 6 and 7 allow truck pass but tunnel higher and costlier, so 5 best.

l-m-h3-b0d10-14.title: How deep parabolic reflector suppose be?
l-m-h3-b0d10-14.goal: Choose reflector depth by weighing all conflicting conditions, find di best balance, and explain why.
l-m-h3-b0d10-14.material: Set depth of parabolic reflector with diameter 40 cm as d (cm). Bulb go sit at focus, wey dey 100/d cm from vertex. Bulb must dey inside opening and at least 8 cm from vertex, and reflector suppose shallow as possible.
l-m-h3-b0d10-14.s.s1.r.a: Focus na about 7.1 cm, wey break condition of at least 8 cm from vertex.
l-m-h3-b0d10-14.s.s1.r.c: Focus na about 11.1 cm from vertex, wey outside opening (9 cm).
l-m-h3-b0d10-14.s.s1.r.d: E meet conditions, but e deeper than 11 cm, so less suitable.
l-m-h3-b0d10-14.s.s1.explain: 100/d must be less than d and at least 8. So 10<d≤12.5, and shallowest choice na 11 cm.
l-m-h3-b0d10-14.s.s2.model.0: For focus to dey inside opening, d must pass 10, and to be at least 8 cm from vertex, d must be 12.5 or less. Among choices wey meet conditions, shallowest, 11 cm, suitable.
l-m-h3-b0d10-14.s.s2.model.1: With 9 cm bulb go outside, and with 14 cm e too close, so both no work. 11 cm, wey shallower than 12 cm, best.

l-m-h3-b0d10-27.material: 2 people dey pull object. One force na F₁=(4, 3). Other force F₂ get magnitude 6 or less, and result must point due east (right). From these, choose candidate with biggest result.
l-m-h3-b0d10-27.s.s1.r.a: Result na (9, 2), so e no point due east.

l-m-h3-b0d10-27.s.s1.r.d: Result na (6, 0), meeting conditions, but another candidate bigger.

l-m-h3-b0d10-27.s.s2.model.0: Result y-component must be 0, so F₂ y-component na −3; among magnitudes 6 or less, (5,−3), with biggest x, give result 9, best.
l-m-h3-b0d10-27.s.s2.model.1: (8,−3) give bigger result but pass force limit 6, so remove am; (2,−3) meet conditions but give smaller result.

l-m-h3-b0d10-28.material: Dem go build hub among cities A(0,0), B(6,0), and C(0,6). From candidate hub locations (position vectors), choose one where distance to farthest city no more than 4.8 and, within dat, sum of distances to three cities smallest.
l-m-h3-b0d10-28.s.s1.r.b: Sum of distances small, but distance to B and C na about 5.1, wey pass 4.8.

l-m-h3-b0d10-28.s.s2.model.0: For K and L farthest distance pass 4.8, so rule dem out. From G and H wey remain, G with smaller sum of about 11.8 fit.
l-m-h3-b0d10-28.s.s2.model.1: H dey evenly close to three cities, but sum 12.7 longer, so choose G, wey meet conditions and get smallest sum.

l-m-h3-b0d10-43.goal: As you choose size of spherical balloon, weigh conflicting conditions, choose best compromise and explain why.
l-m-h3-b0d10-43.material: Spherical balloon float at center (3, 3, 1.5) of room wey wide 6 m, long 6 m, high 3 m. Balloon must stay at least 0.2 m from walls, floor and ceiling, and should be as big as possible.
l-m-h3-b0d10-43.s.s1.r.a: Diameter 3.6 m no fit inside room wey height 3 m.
l-m-h3-b0d10-43.s.s1.r.b: Room plenty, but e fit bigger.
l-m-h3-b0d10-43.s.s1.r.d: E touch floor and ceiling, so e break 0.2 m gap condition.
l-m-h3-b0d10-43.s.s1.explain: Center dey 1.5 m from floor and ceiling, so radius at most 1.5−0.2=1.3 m. Walls dey 3 m away, so space plenty. Biggest value na 1.3 m.
